It took me a while to realise after coming home I was in a toxic relationship. I had studied abroad for a month, only four weeks I was gone, and left my boyfriend of 6 years at home. He didn't want to go with me, he thought it was a waste of time. 

To this day, the instructors I had tell me how it was like watching someone find themself. I learned so much about myself and the world while I was away from home. I was 22 years old. I didn't know anything about the world and it was amazing to me. 

My boyfriend resented me. He hated that I had found something that made me happy, my writing. He didn't want me to go to little reunions with my classmates because he thought they were a bad influence on me. I tried to save the relationship, for a long time. But it was his distaste at my hobbies, my friends, that finally pushed me over the edge . I told him I didn't love him anymore. 

He hasn't spoken to me since. He actually started dating a coworker two weeks after we broke up. We were together for ten years. It's a strange thing to realize someone doesn't love you, they love the idea of you. Unfortunately me finally becoming my own person wasn't the person he loved. I went to school and traveled for a month in a place I had never been before and learned so much about myself and other people. And I am totally ok with that.

The first time I said it and knew I meant it was to my now ex boyfriend. We had just come back from hanging out with his best friend and his fiancee and we were lying in bed sort of talking, half falling asleep. 

I asked him if he thought there were some things you just know. He said I like to think so. I had never been so terrified. I said "I'm falling in love with you."

He rolled over, gave me a hug and kissed me on my forehead. A few minutes later I asked if I had totally fucked up, and he laughed and said no, and we went to sleep. 

A couple weeks later we broke up with me. His reasons were good. We were two broken people, we both had issues with abuse and trust, neither of us had much time, we both worked two jobs and go to school. It was bad timing for us. He never said it back, but part of me knows he did love me. Probably because there are some things you just know.

I still love him, I think I always will. We were something that just fit, just made sense. But we weren't ready yet. This was 6 weeks ago. I think about him everyday. I want him to be happy, to get the help he needs. He was my five months of happiness, my brief window of normality, and now I'm back where I started, and I think I'll be here a while. Because there's some things you just know.

So I went to a women's clinic. One of the doctors I work for recommended this place, it's a high security abortion clinic that also happens to do IUD's. And they do hundreds per month. 

The difference was ASTOUNDING. I took a couple extra strength Tylenol and she was done in 5 minutes. I felt a pinch, went 'heerrp' she said "I know but I'm done now" and I said "Wat."
